title: Three-Dimensional Geometry in Exceptional Algebra
summary: We review some topics in "exceptional mathematics'' from the perspective of 3-dimensional geometry: the octonions $\mathbb{O}$, the split octonions $\mathbb{O}'$, the bioctonions $\mathbb{O}_\mathbb{C} \cong \mathbb{C} \otimes_\mathbb{R} \mathbb{O}$, the complex Albert algebra $\mathfrak{h}_3(\mathbb{O}_\mathbb{C})$, and the complex form of the exceptional Lie algebra $\mathfrak{e}_6$. We show how to functorially build an algebra isomorphic to $\mathbb{O}$ from any 3d complex vector space equipped with an inner product and complex volume form.
